approval.ownerStatement: This is good. Proceed with these changes to all the models and apply them all the way through everywhere, including the game.
approval.scope: Original four-mount body, legs and inboard weapons with Ironclad forearms. Each outer weapon retains 25% of its original Ironclad barrel projection measured forward from the elbow armor seam.

equipment: Two forearm HAILSTORM/4 launcher pods with sixteen physical openings each and six gameplay tubes, plus two compact RATTLER guns in recessed inboard torso pockets. Shared solid boot feet replace the separated toes.

rework.scope: The four-mount concept and original body, rig, inboard sockets and feet carry forward from the previous export. The current forearm selection is recorded in approval.
rework.sourceRigPolicy: Existing source rig and animation indices retained; two torso-owned inboard sockets appended without modifying high-detail source.

previousApproval.scope: Historical approval of the previous two-mount SNES-style Maul A; the linked comparison depicts that previous export.
